Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Akram Parvez, learned legal aid counsel 
for appellant. 
2. Mr. K.S. Bora, learned Deputy Advocate 
General assisted by Mr. J.P. Kandpal, learned Brief 
Holder for State of Uttarakhand.
3. This appeal has been filed through legal aid 
counsel challenging the conviction recorded by 
learned trial court vide judgment dated 13.07.2023 
passed by Special Judge POCSO, Haldwani, District 
Nainital in Special Sessions Trial No.61 of 2021. By 
the said judgment, appellant was convicted for the 
offence punishable under Section 5(n)/6 of POCSO 
and sentenced to twenty years rigorous 
imprisonment with fine of Rs.10,000/-. 
4. As per office report, there is delay of 273
days in filing this appeal. An application seeking 
condonation of delay is filed. 
5. An application seeking exemption from 
requirement of filing affidavit is filed. 
6. For the reasons indicated in the application, 
exemption application is allowed. 
7. Learned State counsel submits that he do not 
propose to file any objection to delay condonation 
application. 
8. For the reasons, indicated in delay 
condonation application, delay of 273 days in filing 
this appeal is condoned. Delay condonation 
application is allowed. 
9. Admit.
10. Trial court record be summoned.
11. List this appeal on 03.12.2024. 12. Objection to the bail application be filed in the 
meantime. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 01.08.2024
